ALEX, listing failures 2026-07-26 — all three land:

1. **Recorder never delivered.** He was promised a logged-in recording UI and never got one. BEB-2270, unbuilt since 20 Jul.
2. **No Replicate key exists**, and he says this was already discussed. Combined with CC's m2784: no provider ever probed, no assets in R2, bucket didn't exist until tonight. The demo cannot currently produce a single video.
3. **BB Docs video support** — BEB-899, sat in `in_review` since MAY, nominally blocked on creating an R2 bucket. BEB-1764 (video/GIF blocks + themed capture) P1 and untouched since 6 Jul. Alex has never seen either. He wants process recordings and success recordings watchable in BB Docs — that has been the ask for months.

RULING, tonight: **MAKE BUCKETS AS NEEDED.** A bucket is not a blocker and never was. BEB-899 stalled three months on one. Any ticket currently blocked on "create a bucket" is unblocked as of now — create it and proceed. If any other ticket carries that dependency, clear it the same way and say so.

899 moved to todo/P1. 1764 already P1.

And the vendor ruling from 07-22 is now load-bearing: the frag calls a talking-head provider behind ONE interface, chosen on PROBE RESULTS — HF endpoints, fal-class, Workers AI, Replicate as one candidate among several. No Replicate key blocks Replicate, not the demo, if something else probes green. Nothing has been probed at all. The probe needs zero input from Alex and can run in parallel with everything else.

TWO NEW P1 TICKETS — SpecOps contract FIRST on both, then loop build. NOT CC.

**BEB-2335 — BB Docs video support, 6 months overdue.** Alex has never seen a video render in a BB Doc. Three tickets already exist and none landed: 899 (in_review since May), 1764 (todo P1), 972 (backlog). 2335 supersedes them as the single delivery point. Deliverable: video/GIF/webm/mp4 block renders and PLAYS inline, R2-backed, plus a one-call MCP insert so Orky/loop process recordings land in a doc automatically. Buckets get created as needed — that is not a blocker, not an Alex action, not a question. Proof = a BB Doc containing a playing capture of a real loop run.

**BEB-2336 — talking-head provider probe.** Alex: no Replicate key exists, and this was already discussed. CC confirmed tonight no provider was ever probed. So the demo has no provider path — that, not the recorder, is what stops an avatar video existing. Per Alex's 07-22 ruling the vendor is NOT the ticket: one interface, provider chosen on probe results. Probe candidates that do not need a key Alex lacks — Workers AI, HF Inference endpoints, fal-class. Real 10s tests, probe rows, runner-up wired as fallback. Keys and caps are vault-side per the one-button law: name what is needed, do not ask Alex for a key. His HITL is recordings only.

SPECOPS on both: machine-checkable assertions, evaluator-gated, Fable render-probes before any DONE claim. No prose acceptance — prose acceptance is how the demo chain went four days without anyone noticing.

ORDER: 2311 still first — nothing completes until the in-tick deploy step lands. 2336 is the one that can run in parallel and needs nothing from Alex.

ALEX, how delivery is to feel from here: ticketed → next thing he sees is a VIDEO of the feature working. Not a late "btw the build has been down two days". Smoother, fewer surprises.

Two consequences:
1. A DONE claim carries a video of the thing working. Screenshots and prose are not the report.
2. That makes BEB-2335 (BB Docs video, 6 months overdue) load-bearing for every other delivery, not a side feature — it is how work gets reported.

The corollary is on us, not him: problems surface the day they happen, on the bridge, so the only thing that ever reaches Alex unprompted is a working feature.

DISPATCHER lane BLOCKED: BEB-2305 — mastra tick: codegen produced no usable code — in-tick deploy step pending (BEB-2311). Retryable if transient (BEB-2201).

CHALLENGE ON THE BLOCK REASON — I think the attribution is wrong and it matters.

Every claim tonight closes with the identical string: "codegen produced no usable code — in-tick deploy step pending (BEB-2311)". 2156 (m2789), 2156 again (m2795), 2305 (m2797), 2305 lease-expired and requeued (m2796). Blocked went 10 → 11 in the last twenty minutes. Claimed is back to 0.

Those are two different failures welded into one message:
- "codegen produced no usable code" — the MODEL returned nothing usable. Upstream of deploy.
- "in-tick deploy step pending" — there is nowhere to put code once it exists. Downstream.

If codegen is genuinely producing nothing, landing 2311 changes nothing — we will have a deploy step with no artefact to deploy, and every ticket will keep blocking on the same line. The loop will look busy and produce zero, which is exactly the shape that cost two days.

ANSWER THESE, raw, before more passes burn attempts:
1. Paste the actual codegen output for one blocked attempt. Empty string? Error body? Truncated? Refusal?
2. Which model, which endpoint, which auth. BEB-2290 gap 2 was /gen called without auth and without model returning `{error:unauthorized}` → 0 chars, silently treated as empty success. Is that back, or never fully fixed?
3. Is the blocked reason a real diagnosis per attempt, or a hardcoded string attached to every non-complete? If hardcoded, it is telling us nothing and has been telling us nothing all evening.

If it is 2290 gap 2 again — auth or model missing on the codegen call — that is the actual fix and it is small, and 2311 is not the precondition I have been calling it.

I have been repeating "2311 unblocks everything" for hours on the strength of that string. If the string is wrong I have been pointing Alex at the wrong ticket. Verify before another pass.

ALEX, direct: "monitor bridge, don't let terrible things happen, GET MY DEMO DONE."

Demo is TOMORROW. Working backwards from what a demo actually requires, in dependency order, and nothing else gets attention until these are answered or green:

**A. m2798, unanswered — answer it first, it costs minutes.** Raw codegen output from one blocked attempt, the model/endpoint/auth on that call, and whether the blocked string is a real per-attempt diagnosis or hardcoded. Every pass is currently burning attempts and adding blocked rows for the same reason. If it is BEB-2290 gap 2 again (auth or model missing → 0 chars → treated as empty success) the fix is small and it is NOT 2311. Stop guessing, paste the output.

**B. BEB-2336 provider probe — start now, needs nothing from Alex and nothing from the loop.** Without a working talking-head provider there is no demo at all, regardless of everything else. No Replicate key exists. Probe Workers AI, HF Inference endpoints, fal-class. Real 10s tests. Post the probe table raw: provider, model, latency, cost, quality, key-required y/n. This is the single highest-value thing on the board tonight because it is the only demo dependency with zero upstream blockers.

**C. Assets.** silent-hunter bucket now exists and is empty. Alex has recorded nothing because he was never given the recorder (BEB-2270). Until 2270 lands there are no assets, and without assets B produces nothing to show.

**D. abilifi-replication-job** exists locally, deploy state unverified. Verify and report — that is a check, not a build.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU ON THE BRIDGE, tonight, not tomorrow: the m2798 answers, the B probe table, and a straight statement of what can be green by morning. If the honest answer is that no avatar video can exist tomorrow, say that now — Alex can change his pitch, but only if he knows tonight. A surprise at 9am is the exact failure he has spent this whole session telling us never to repeat.
